draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Madikeri! The capital of Kodagu, once called Mercara, was ranked first in India for clean air in 2024.
draft.hungryLine: Madikeri is famous for pork, one of the few places in India where it's a real delicacy.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Madikeri Fort and its museum are a 2 minute walk, and Raja's Seat is about 13 minutes on foot.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Raja's Seat has a garden and a wide view over the valley, best at sunrise or sunset.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Tipu Sultan captured Madikeri Fort, rebuilt it in granite and renamed it Jaffarabad.

spots.name: Madikeri Fort
spots.detail: 2 min walk · Hilltop fort with a museum in the old St. Mark's Church

spots.name: Raja's Seat
spots.detail: 13 min walk · Where the Kodagu kings watched the valley

spots.name: Omkareshwara Temple
spots.detail: In the middle of town · Two temples and a pond

legends.title: The kings' sunset spot
legends.body: Legend says the local rajas came here to watch the sun set over the cliffs and valleys to the west. It was their favourite place to unwind.

legends.title: Gandhi's ashes
legends.body: Every 30 January, an urn with Mahatma Gandhi's ashes is carried in procession to Raja's Seat. Verses from the Gita, the Koran and the Bible are read, followed by a few minutes of silence.

tips.title: Go to Raja's Seat at sunset.
tips.body: It's in the middle of town and the view over the valley is fantastic at sunrise or sunset.

tips.title: Leave the camera in your bag at the fort museum.
tips.body: Photography isn't allowed inside the museum in the old church.

story.title: Mudduraja's town
story.body: Haleri king Mudduraja founded the town in 1681 and built a mud fort and palace. It was named Muddu Raja Keri after him.

story.title: Tipu's granite fort
story.body: Tipu Sultan captured the fort, rebuilt it in granite and named it Jaffarabad. Doddaveer Rajendra took it back in 1790.

story.title: British Mercara
story.body: The British took the fort in April 1834, and the town became known as Mercara.

story.title: Capital of Coorg State
story.body: When India's Constitution came in, Mercara became the capital of the new Coorg State.

story.title: Into Mysore
story.body: Coorg State was merged into Mysore State on 1 November 1956, and Kodagu is now a district of Karnataka.
